# Slasher: Chicken Mask
[color=#ac3a0d]"Do you like hurting other people?"[/color]
The Chicken Mask is a prestige kit - ascend (reach 15 souls) as the [bold]Butcher[/bold] to unlock it.
## What's different
- [bold]Hotline vision.[/bold] Everything outside your field of view and all of space gets a neon overlay.
- [bold]Shared dread.[/bold] Victims you hunt see the same neon overlay as well.
